pageProps.review: This work, which Keigo Higashino mentioned as his ambitious project, contains the charm of high-density mystery that digs into the dark inner self and truth of humans through fragments of memory in a limited space with only two characters.
pageProps.description: I must go to that house
pageProps.content:
## Review A high-density mystery that digs into the dark inner self and fragments of memory of humans in the extreme setting of only two characters and a limited space.
The process where the truth perfectly converges at the end by collecting the clues scattered in the work along with the reader clearly shows the author's characteristic plot construction ability.
The author himself mentioned this work as his ambitious project.
But the protagonist is frustrating.
